control-implementation.description: One implemented requirement per NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 requirement, one statement per assessment objective (ADR-0008).

by-components.description: Authorized users are managed in Microsoft Entra ID; the Entra user list is the authorized user list.
Devices are authorized by being joined to Entra ID.
Purchasing and Accounting see their own modules, machinists see the traveler and CAM files relevant to the job in front of them, and Dana Ortiz has full access as owner.
Access to ShopTrak, the SAG-NAS shares, and email is limited by job role. SharePoint and OneDrive permissions mirror the same role groups.
There is no written information flow control policy.
No technical control stops CUI from leaving on an email to any external address.

CUI moves from the MeridianLink portal, through Priya Natarajan's engineering package, into the traveler and g-code, out to Sonoran Anodize and Plating by email, and back through Maria Chen's First Article Inspection report.
The FAI report has been scanned to a personal Gmail address on at least one occasion, and the drawing is emailed to the finisher as a matter of course.

Saguaro is a twelve-person shop with limited separation of duties. Ellen Park issues purchase orders and Rob Castellano pays them; Dana Ortiz personally reviews the bank statement each month, which is the only separation control in place for financial transactions. Engineering (Priya Natarajan), programming (Tom Reyes), and machining (Kevin Marsh, Ana Delgado, Sam Whitfield) are separate people performing separate steps of the same job.
Only Dana Ortiz and the two Northstar Global Administrator accounts hold administrative rights in Microsoft 365.
Local administrator rights on the Windows endpoints belong to Northstar's build account; end users are standard users on their own machines.

Staff sign in to their day-to-day work (email, ShopTrak, the SAG-NAS shares) with their own standard Entra account. Nobody uses an administrative account for ordinary work; the two Global Administrator accounts belong to Northstar and are not used by Saguaro staff at all.
Standard users cannot install software or change system settings on their own Windows 11 endpoints; Windows UAC blocks privileged actions and prompts for elevation.
Local Windows event logs record UAC elevation attempts, subject to the 20 MB local rollover described under 3.3.1.
Accounts are locked after 5 consecutive invalid logon attempts within 15 minutes and remain locked for 30 minutes. [TO BE CONFIRMED: whether this lockout also applies to local accounts on SAG-NAS]
No additional CUI-specific privacy or security notice has been drafted or deployed.
The Windows sign-in screen on every endpoint displays the standard Microsoft 365 organizational sign-in notice.
Windows 11 endpoints lock the screen after 10 minutes of inactivity.
Windows 11 endpoints lock the screen after 10 minutes of inactivity.
SHOP-PC-01 does not have a lock screen policy configured; it relies on the physical layout of the shop floor.
CMM-PC does not have a lock screen policy configured; it relies on the physical layout of the shop floor.
The lock screen hides the desktop content.
Microsoft 365 sign-in sessions expire per the default Entra ID sign-in frequency setting.
Windows sessions on the endpoints are not automatically terminated; a user who steps away stays signed in until the screen lock engages.
Dana Ortiz's only user remote access path is the EdgeRouter's L2TP/IPsec VPN from her home PC, followed by an RDP session into OFFICE-DANA.

The VPN is the only remote access method in use by Saguaro staff. Northstar's remote control sessions through the RMM are a separate access path and are treated under 3.1.20 and the ESP scoping decision, not here.
The L2TP/IPsec VPN tunnel that Dana Ortiz uses encrypts traffic between her home PC and the EdgeRouter.
The RDP session from Dana Ortiz's home PC into OFFICE-DANA, once inside the tunnel, uses Windows' default RDP encryption.
The only remote access control point is the EdgeRouter's VPN server.
Every remote session from a Saguaro user passes through the EdgeRouter's VPN server before reaching any endpoint.

Northstar's remote control sessions through the RMM can reach any endpoint without going through the VPN, because the RMM agent runs locally on each machine and calls out to Northstar's cloud service. No Saguaro-side authorization step gates an individual Northstar remote session.
The Wi-Fi network "Saguaro" was set up by Northstar when the office was built out.
No separate authorization step exists for a new device joining Wi-Fi beyond knowing the WPA2-PSK password on the break room sticky note.
Wi-Fi uses WPA2-PSK for authentication. The same SSID and password serve staff and guests alike.
Wi-Fi uses WPA2-PSK for encryption. The same SSID and password serve staff and guests alike.
No mobile device management is deployed. Personal phones connect to Exchange Online through the built-in mail app over the carrier data connection or the office Wi-Fi.

CUI is not stored at rest on personal phones as a matter of design, but attachments received in Outlook on a personal phone are not encrypted by any Saguaro-controlled mechanism beyond the phone's own device encryption.
Saguaro does not connect to external systems.

implementation-status.remarks: The company website is static marketing content with no CUI and no upload capability.

by-components.description: The Microsoft 365 unified audit log is enabled by default and records sign-in and administrative activity across Exchange Online, SharePoint, and OneDrive.
SAG-NAS keeps no audit log at all.
SHOP-PC-01 keeps no audit log at all.
CMM-PC keeps no audit log at all.
Windows event logs on the eight office endpoints stay local with a 20 MB rollover and are not centrally collected. There is no SIEM and no scheduled log review.
Northstar's two Global Administrator accounts have MFA enrolled.
Multifactor authentication (Microsoft Authenticator) is required by Conditional Access for every user's Microsoft 365 sign-in.

Northstar supplied a two-page incident response plan template, stored at policies/incident-response-plan.md. The plan has never been exercised; no tabletop exercise or test has been scheduled or recorded.

CUI leaves Saguaro on USB sticks, printed drawings, printed travelers, and the weekly backup drive. None of these carry a CUI marking. policies/media-handling-policy.md says media containing CUI "should be labeled" but gives no procedure for doing so.
CUI leaves Saguaro on USB sticks, printed drawings, printed travelers, and the weekly backup drive. None of these carry a distribution limitation.
The system boundary for this SSP is the Saguaro office network and Microsoft 365.
All CUI at rest is protected by BitLocker and in transit by TLS.
